heading: Tuesday, September 30, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Zhipu AI GLM-4.6 and OpenAI Sora 2.

items.headline: Z.ai releases GLM-4.6
items.summary: GLM-4.6 is Z.ai's flagship update to GLM-4.5, expanding the context window from 128K to 200K tokens and improving coding, reasoning, tool use and search agents. Weights are MIT-licensed; Z.ai reports competitive results against DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus and Claude Sonnet 4 across eight benchmarks.

image.alt: GLM-4.6 benchmark chart against GLM-4.5, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp and Claude Sonnet 4 and 4.5

items.headline: OpenAI releases Sora 2 video and audio model
items.summary: Sora 2 generates video with synchronized dialogue and sound effects, which OpenAI says is more physically accurate and controllable than earlier systems. It launched with an invite-based Sora iOS app in the US and Canada, with a higher-quality Sora 2 Pro for ChatGPT Pro users.
